visual.description: AI-generated image of a human body silhouette (dark, translucent, anatomical outline style) on #2A2A32 background. Three location markers appear sequentially with blur-fade-in: (1) Lungs — small cluster of pink fiber particles, (2) Brain — cluster of fiber particles, (3) Placenta — cluster of fiber particles. Each location label in Inter 400 with connecting line. Film grain overlay for documentary feel. No faces, no identifiable features — just the anatomical outline.
visual.sourceText: Source: Leslie et al., Env. Int., 2022
